topic: Egg recall due to Salmonella contamination
headline: EGG INDUSTRY ROCKED BY SALMONELLA OUTBREAK: DOZENS FALL ILL, RECALLS ISSUED ACROSS UK AND US
summary: Dozens of people have fallen ill due to salmonella contamination in eggs, with at least 45 cases reported in the UK and 79 cases in the US. The contaminated eggs have been linked to specific farms and producers, including the August Egg Company in California. As a result, recalls have been issued, and consumers have been advised to discard or return affected eggs. The outbreaks have raised concerns about food safety and the risk of salmonella contamination in the egg industry.
